recommended_pre_drop_sequence: 1. Confirm production env has no DOCUMENTS_HUB_* legacy flags set
2. Export row counts + storage orphan audit for customer_files, project_documents, document_migration_map
3. Complete backfill for unmigrated legacy rows (if any) or accept archival
4. Link or archive orphan project_documents on lead_id IS NULL projects
6. Ops soak signoff (14–30d zero legacy writes)
7. New migration: DROP or rename legacy tables + document_migration_map (explicit approval)
8. Remove comment-only mapping helpers or rename for clarity (optional cleanup)
